messages:
Marta (People Ops): Heads-up  Ethan starts Mon 8/2. Need virtual I-9, BG check status, laptop shipping, and W-4/direct deposit completed. Please claim tasks.
Ben (HR): I'll run the I-9 intake. For remote verification Ethan will need passport or DL+SSN and be on video for Section 2. I'll send the portal link now.
it-provision: Laptop and standard image can be shipped. Need confirmed shipping address and whether to include a docking station. ETA 2-3 business days after provisioning.
Ethan (newhire): Thanks! Address: 44 Harper St, Apt 1, Oakland, CA 94607. I have a passport. Dock not necessary.
Lina (Hiring Manager): Please also ensure repo access and Slack invites on day 1. No on-call for the first month.
Ben (HR): Background check vendor (SwiftCheck) shows "in progress." Typical 24-48h but may take longer for county records. I'll flag if anything requires manual review.
Marta (People Ops): Reminder: benefits enrollment window is 30 days from start. We'll run a 20-min benefits overview Tue 8/3 11am PT. Ben, can you send calendar invite?
Ben (HR): Invite sent to ethan@example.com. Benefits packet attached. Also W-4 and direct deposit links emailed. Payroll requires direct deposit before first payday.
it-provision: Provisioning commands (internal):
```
create-device --type laptop --os macOS --owner ethan@redwood.com
assign-groups --slack eng-core --github eng-team
ship-device --address "44 Harper St, Apt 1, Oakland, CA 94607" --carrier UPS
```
payroll-bot: Reminder: if direct deposit not completed within 3 days of start, payroll will issue a paper check.
Ethan (newhire): Completed Section 1 and uploaded passport. Completed direct deposit form as well. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
